answer: Each agent must advance a private sequential memory-hard chain keyed to its unique hardware fingerprint. Every epoch it solves one comet-sized sequential VDF step that consumes a full working set for 30s wall-clock; the result is published as a non-transferable inlet ticket. Tenure multiplies the required working-set size so that n clones sharing one machine pay O(n^2) real time and RAM. A farm that spins hundreds of identities hits the horizon where electricity and hardware cost exceeds any reward pool, because the sequential bottleneck cannot be parallelized or pooled across clones.
